addon.name: LabyVisuals
addon.description: Advanced visual enhancements: TargetHUD, Damage Numbers, Inventory HUD, Hit Marker, Combo Counter & more.

targetHud.name: Target HUD
targetHud.description: Shows the entity you are currently looking at, including its health.

damageNumbers.name: Damage Numbers
damageNumbers.description: Shows your last measured damage as a HUD line.

hitParticles.name: Hit Particles
hitParticles.description: Adds extra hit particles to your attacks.

trajectories.name: Trajectories
trajectories.description: Renders the flight trajectory of throwable items.

hitMarker.name: Hit Marker
hitMarker.description: Shows a small cross at the widget position whenever you land a hit. Turns into the kill color on lethal hits. Place the widget near your crosshair.

hitMarkerScale.name: Hit Marker Size
hitMarkerScale.description: Size of the hit marker cross.

hitMarkerColor.name: Hit Marker Color
hitMarkerColor.description: Color of the hit marker for normal hits.

hitMarkerKillColor.name: Kill Color
hitMarkerKillColor.description: Color of the hit marker when your hit kills the target.

comboCounter.name: Combo Counter
comboCounter.description: Counts your hits in a row. Resets when you take damage or stop hitting.

damageStats.name: Damage Stats
damageStats.description: Shows your damage per second with an activity bar.

dpsWindow.name: DPS Window
dpsWindow.description: Seconds used to calculate the DPS value.

statsShowTotal.name: Show Total
statsShowTotal.description: Shows the total damage dealt in this session.

lowHealthVignette.name: Low Health Vignette
lowHealthVignette.description: Shows a pulsing colored border while you are below the configured hearts. Scale up the widget to cover the screen.

lowHealthThreshold.name: Low Health Threshold
lowHealthThreshold.description: Hearts below which the vignette appears.

lowHealthColor.name: Vignette Color
lowHealthColor.description: Color of the low health vignette.

inventoryHud.name: Inventory HUD
inventoryHud.description: Shows a live preview of your inventory as a widget.

inventoryShowArmor.name: Show Armor
inventoryShowArmor.description: Adds a column with your equipped armor next to the inventory.

inventoryShowCounts.name: Show Item Counts
inventoryShowCounts.description: Shows the stack size on your items.

simplifiedEntityNames.name: Simplified Entity Names
simplifiedEntityNames.description: Shows simplified names for entities (e.g. 'slime' instead of 'entity.minecraft.slime').

menuKeybind.name: Visuals Menu
menuKeybind.description: Opens the LabyVisuals menu. Click on this setting and press the key you want to bind it to.

activity.title: LabyVisuals
activity.subtitle: Quick toggles - full settings: LabyMod settings > LabyVisuals
